verdict.rationale: LiveKit documents a first-party Docs MCP server that coding agents and IDEs can install. Its stated scope is answering LiveKit documentation questions, not operating LiveKit resources such as rooms, agents or deployments. missing for 10: an MCP server exposing platform/API operations, documented setup and transport details, an explicit tool list, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Install it in your IDE or coding agent to get accurate, up-to-date LiveKit answers without leaving your editor.
Turn your favorite coding agent into a LiveKit expert with skills, docs, and tools.
